Definition: of uncertain origin; Lasæa, a place in Crete:--Lasea.
BiblicalUsage: Lasaía means Lasea, a place in Crete. In Acts 27:8, "came unto a place which is called The fair havens".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a passing mention of a Cretan harbour reminds me that Paul's voyage to Rome was real — real seas, real ports, real danger.
